# archestra_chatops_slack_agent_bot (Resource)

A Slack app whose bot always answers as one agent, in addition to the organization's Slack app (`archestra_chatops_slack`). Each agent has at most one bot. Secrets are write-only: the API never returns them, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. Destroying the resource disconnects the bot. Enabling it checks the bot token with Slack.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "support_bot_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "support_app_level_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

data "archestra_agent" "support" {
  name = "Support"
}

# A second Slack app whose bot always answers as the Support agent.
resource "archestra_chatops_slack_agent_bot" "support" {
  agent_id        = data.archestra_agent.support.id
  connection_mode = "socket"
  app_id          = "A0987654321"
  bot_token       = var.support_bot_token
  app_level_token = var.support_app_level_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) ID of the agent the bot answers as.

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) Slack app ID. It must differ from the organization's app and from every other agent's bot.
- `app_level_token` (String, Sensitive) Slack app-level token (`xapp-…`), used in socket mode.
- `bot_token` (String, Sensitive) Slack bot token (`xoxb-…`).
- `connection_mode` (String) How Slack reaches Archestra: `socket` or `webhook`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the bot is on.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) Slack signing secret, used in webhook mode.

### Read-Only

- `bot_user_id` (String) Slack user ID of the bot.
- `connected` (Boolean) Whether the bot is connected to Slack.
- `id` (String) Agent ID.
- `team_id` (String) Slack workspace ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The agent ID.
terraform import archestra_chatops_slack_agent_bot.support 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
